standard_prerequisites.name: For an affine morphism the pushforward of a derived tensor with the pullback of the structure sheaf is the derived tensor of the pushforward, and for an affine base change the pushforward of the structure sheaf of the fibre product is the pullback of the pushforward of the structure sheaf

standard_prerequisites.name: Tor independence of two rings over a base means all higher Tor vanish, equivalently the derived tensor product agrees with the ordinary one
standard_prerequisites.use: Converts the Tor independence hypothesis into the equality Lf^*g_*O_{S'} = f^*g_*O_{S'} that finishes the proof.

core_obligations: Get the canonical base change map from Cohomology, Remark base-change, valid for every E in D(O_X); observe the asserted invertibility is local on S', so assume g : S' to S is a morphism of affine schemes, in particular affine (proof lines 5379-5390).

It suffices to show that Rg_*Lg^*Rf_*E to Rg_*Rf'_*L(g')^*E = Rf_*(Rg'_*L(g')^*E) is an isomorphism, see Lemma affine-morphism, using Lemmas quasi-coherence-pullback, quasi-coherence-tensor-product, and quasi-coherence-direct-image to see the objects have quasi-coherent cohomology sheaves; note g' is affine too by Morphisms, Lemma base-change-affine (proof lines 5390-5398).

By Lemma affine-morphism-pull-push the map becomes Rf_*E tensor^L g_*O_{S'} to Rf_*(E tensor^L g'_*O_{X'}); observe g'_*O_{X'} = f^*g_*O_{S'} by affine base change (Cohomology of Schemes, Lemma affine-base-change), so by Lemma cohomology-base-change it suffices to prove Lf^*g_*O_{S'} = f^*g_*O_{S'} (proof lines 5398-5410).

Verify Lf^*g_*O_{S'} = f^*g_*O_{S'} from Tor independence: check locally on X, so assume X = Spec(A), S = Spec(R), S' = Spec(R'); the hypothesis makes A and R' Tor independent over R (More on Algebra, Lemma tor-independent), i.e. Tor_i^R(A, R') = 0 for i > 0, so A tensor_R^L R' = A tensor_R R', which by Lemma quasi-coherence-pullback is exactly Lf^*g_*O_{S'} = f^*g_*O_{S'} (proof lines 5410-5417).
proof_roadmap: Take the canonical base change map and reduce to affine g by locality on S' (proof lines 5379-5390).
Push both sides through Rg_* and rewrite via the affine pull-push formula (proof lines 5390-5398).
Identify g'_*O_{X'} = f^*g_*O_{S'} and reduce to Lf^* = f^* on g_*O_{S'} (proof lines 5398-5410).
Conclude by Tor independence on affine charts (proof lines 5410-5417).
